_comment: BATTLE HISTORY on the painted page host. The page is the painting with the tab words and the seven painted rows erased -- the list filled from the page's own ground outside its frame (x 2-20: flat navy, 0.5 of variation down the whole list, where the three columns beside the rows varied 15 with the rows' shadows and striped the list); the rows are drawn live from the four the painting shows, one per outcome (won: gold swords, lost: red sword, held: silver shield, raided: red gauntlet), 113 tall at a 121 pitch as painted. The tab plates are ALL's lit and ON ME's unlit, their words erased: the painting spells the second tab MY RADS, so every tab word is set in type.

crops.name: history/page
crops.note: The painted ALL / MY RADS / ON ME plates are lifted whole (refill, y 517-594 between the subtitle and the list): the tabs are the game's short plates (tabs_sheet_c.png), drawn by TabStrip, so the painting's own, spelled MY RADS, is gone from under them.
